The '''Southern Wasteland''' was one of the three major landmasses on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kathol (planet)|Kathol]]. It was bordered by the [[Central Ocean]], [[Triad Sea]], and [[Southern Ocean (Kathol)|Southern Ocean]]. The continent was deserted except for a [[Charr Ontee]] enclave dedicated to [[Terraforming/Legends|terraforming]] the region.
